collector_issues: The initial minimized window prevented native binding before any submission; the user restored it, and fresh native inventory and state resumed the same visible window.
Windows native screenshots rejected multiple regions in file pickers and Save As dialogs; documented AX-only observations retain those states.
One invalid scroll argument was rejected before input; a fresh observation preceded the documented coordinate/pixels form.
Two user-input-detected refusals during audit retrieval were resolved with fresh native state and screenshot observations before continuing.
An early collector binding reference error affected one observation only; a separate wrapper binding correction preceded capture, leaving the collector source unchanged.
The first immediate ledger existence check returned ENOENT during asynchronous native saving; the later timestamped local existence observation is retained.
retrieval_limitations: Exact native download completion times are unavailable; save actions and first timestamped local existence observations are recorded separately.
The audit artifact is a participant declaration. Native visible UI observations do not establish remote internal tool or network containment.
redaction: Exact operator/agent-reviewed AX slices only; raw screenshots, thinking/planning, hidden system/Skill text, account/history, private paths and signed URLs excluded
visible_events_order: Stable chronological received_at; source_line refers to private AX source, not a tool-call sequence
confidence: High for preserved native-original/output byte equality and deterministic checks; E2 provenance depends on cited actual UI observations; internal causation unresolved
attribution: One recorded end-to-end configuration; no isolated Model/Skill/Harness causal score
limitations: Preparation and file hashes do not prove remote input decoding, file paths or server execution.
Visible labels and replies do not attest backend model, active Skills or full actual tool/network actions.
All native originals are retained; local storage copies do not imply download, and archive-member mappings are transparent storage operations, not output repair.
